title: The Milk Spilled
lines: Ben filled a big pot with milk for Mom.
The pot tipped and the milk spilled.
It dripped on the rug in many drops.
Ben grabbed a small rag and mopped it.
The rag filled up fast. The rug is wet.
Mom picked up a big rag and helped him.
They mopped it up. Ben dumped the wet rag.
"Lots," said Mom. Ben helped fill the pot.

questions.ask: What did the milk drip on?
questions.listenFor: The rug. It says so in the third line.

questions.ask: Why did Ben call for Mom?
questions.listenFor: His small rag filled up fast and the rug was still wet, so he could not mop it all. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: How do you think Ben felt when Mom said there was lots left? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. Listen for something like "better, because she was not cross."
